props.name: popoverWidth
props.description:
Width of the option Popover (Popover `width`): unset is Figma's 240px; `"fill"` matches the field's box, `"hug"` grows

props.name: datePickerActions
props.description:
The calendar's Cancel + Submit (Figma Actions): a picked day is a draft until Submit writes it to the field; Cancel and
 Escape keep the date the field had.

props.name: onDateChange
props.description:
The day in the field: called when one is picked in the calendar and when a complete MM/DD/YYYY is typed; null when
 the field is emptied or a typed date stops being a real day.

props.name: minDate
props.description:
Earliest day the calendar lets people pick (DatePicker `minDate`); earlier days are disabled. A typed date before
it stays in the field and reaches `onValueChange` as usual, and the input is marked `aria-invalid` (Form and
ModalForm count it and focus it after a blocked submit). The field shows no message of its own: validate the value
and pass `error` ("Pick a date from 1 October").

props.name: maxDate
props.description:
Latest day the calendar lets people pick (DatePicker `maxDate`); later days are disabled. A typed date after it is
kept, reported and marked `aria-invalid` as for `minDate`: pass `error` to say why.

props.name: today
props.description:
The day the calendar treats as today (DatePicker `today`): its Today ring and the month it opens on while empty.
Default: the device clock.

components.description:
Figma Input/Color-Field (15660:8643): pick or type any colour. The Text-Field anatomy (Label → Field → Help-Text) with
a ColorSwatch before the hex (after it with `layout="inline"`, Figma Input/Inline-Field Type=Color); the swatch size
follows the field's leading icon (sm 16 in Small, md 20 in Medium and Large, lg 24 in XLarge). A click in the field or
ArrowDown opens ColorPicker under it (State=Focused while open); Escape closes it and leaves focus in the field.
Typing edits the hex: six digits apply at once, a shorter one on Enter or blur, anything else goes back to the colour.
The picker is the same popover on every device (Figma has no mobile pattern for it yet).

shorter hex completed on Enter or blur.

components.name: AutocompleteField
components.description:
Figma Input/Autocomplete-Field (1241:5616): Label, a wrapping Tag list (gap 4, Tag Remove=Yes) and an
"Add Item" Button/Main XSmall Secondary that opens Popover/Default (Search + "Search and select" label + items)
over the Add slot. Selected options become tags; the popover closes on outside pointer-down or Escape. Removing a tag

Figma Popover/Manual-Add-New: create a value that isn't in `options`. Add the new option to `options`

Figma Input/Property-Field (16923:6031, page ❖ Input): a property of a record (a task, ticket, deal or file) — an
icon and a label on the left, the value on the right, edited in place. Rows stack in one or two columns of a detail

components.name: InputLabel
components.description:
Public implementation of Figma's `Primitives/Input/Label` (387:3651): Content (label · optional · tooltip icon,
gap 2XSmall) + an optional right-aligned Action. The tooltip icon sits outside the <label> so hovering or
focusing it never activates the field.

props.name: labelId
props.description: id of the <label> element itself, for controls that are named with aria-labelledby (e.g. a rich text editor).

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma `Optional`: appends the locale's "(Optional)" in Content/Neutral/Light.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Figma `Tooltip-Icon`: `true` shows the 12px info icon; text/nodes also show it as a hover/focus Tooltip.

props.name: action
props.description: Figma `Action`: right-aligned Body/Small/Bold slot — a link or a text button (e.g. "Forgot password?").

props.name: disabled
props.description: Figma `State=Disabled`: every part (label, optional, icon, action) turns Content/Disabled.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<span>` element.

components.name: InputLeadingTrailing

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name (`"icon-settings-03-line"`, drawn at the slot's icon size) or any node.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Explicit Figma Label axis. Omit the label while keeping the slot/icon.

props.name: showDropdown
props.description: Explicit Figma Dropdown axis.

props.name: options
props.description: Makes a labelled slot a picker: clicking it opens a Popover with these options (e.g. country code, unit, currency).

props.name: popoverLabel
props.description: Popover/Label above the options, e.g. "Country code" (a label, not a heading). Also the button's accessible name prefix.

props.name: align
props.description: Open the picker towards the start (leading) or end (trailing) of the field.

props.name: interactive
props.description:
Whether the slot is clickable. Defaults to `true` for a labelled slot with `options` (picker) or any slot with
`onClick` (action); otherwise `false` (decorative: a click focuses the field). Set it explicitly per use case.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Action slot (no popover), e.g. a filter or visibility toggle. Makes the slot clickable unless `interactive={false}`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for a clickable slot; required when it has no visible label (icon-only).

props.name: aria-haspopup
props.description: Marks an action slot that opens a menu/popover owned by the caller.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root element: a `<span>` for a decorative slot or picker wrapper, a `<button>` for an action slot.

components.name: ControlBarSelectItem
components.description: Public implementation of Figma's `Control-Bar/Select-Item` primitive.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name (`"icon-bold-02-line"`, drawn at 20px) or any node. Name the item with aria-label.

components.name: RichTextEditorBar
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Rich-Text/Editor-Bar`: Undo/Redo · Text style Select (Small) · Bold/Underline/Italic/Strikethrough ·
alignment · lists and indent · link/image/video · clear formatting, gap Spacing/Gap/2XSmall between blocks and
3XSmall inside a block. Items keep the editor's selection (mouse-down does not steal focus); arrow keys move
between items (ARIA toolbar pattern).

props.name: theme
props.description: Figma Control-Bar/Select-Item Theme used by every item.

props.name: active
props.description: Commands shown as Selected (aria-pressed) — the formatting at the caret.

props.name: disabled
props.description: `true` disables the whole bar (Read-only field); a map disables single commands (e.g. undo with no history).

props.name: controls
props.description: id of the editor the bar formats.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the toolbar. Default: the locale's "Formatting".

props.name: ref
props.description: The root toolbar `<div>`.

components.name: HeadingField
components.description:
Figma Input/Heading (694:13062): an inline-editable heading (no field chrome). Heading/1–3 text, an 8px pad that
sits outside the text box (−8px), radius 12, and a Neutral/Subtle surface on hover/focus/typing. One line by
default; `multiline` wraps long headings and grows with them (Status=Inputted-Multi-Line).

props.name: headingSize
props.description: Heading/1–3 text style.

props.name: multiline
props.description:
`false` (default): one line, for short names (a board, a file, a section); a long heading scrolls inside the field.
`true`: long headings wrap and the field grows with them (Figma Status=Inputted-Multi-Line), for document,
announcement or task titles. It renders a `<textarea>`: Enter never adds a line break (handle it in `onKeyDown`,
e.g. to move on) and pasted line breaks become spaces.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text on every change, in both variants.

props.name: status
props.description: Deterministic Figma Status for matrices; native hover/focus still apply.

props.name: ref
props.description: The native `<input>` (or `<textarea>` with `multiline`).

components.name: InputConditionItem
components.description:
Figma Primitives/Input/Input-Conditions/Condition-Item: 16px icon (Element-Size/Popular/Small) + Body/Small/Regular,
gap 2XSmall. Default: the minus Content/Neutral/Base, the words Neutral/Light; Success Positive/Light (check), Wrong
Negative/Light (x-small).

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<li>` element.

components.name: InputConditions
components.description: Figma Input-Conditions: an Item-List slot stacking Condition-Items with gap XSmall.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<ul>` element.
